Question: That is (niyamat) a girl child to our family.we thankful to allah if you send few names.name should have two point. 1-when we call her, her name it self give us reward (nayki) . 2-in quran or islamic history,allah pleased with person (name) for small qurbani in the path of allah. Make duwa for us. Her akkia will be insha-allah on 8 May. Answer ID: 5493 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 943/943=H) (1) Name the baby girl 'Asiyah' ( آسیہ ). (2) See Behishti Zewar regarding Hazrat Asiyah RZ. (3) May Allah award you, your relatives and the new-born baby (Asiyah) blessings of both the worlds and keep you safe from all troubles, Amen. (4) بارک اللہ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
